title: 日本語の森 N5 — 時間の表現 (Time Expressions)
description: From 日本語の森 (Nihongo no Mori), a YouTube channel that teaches Japanese entirely in Japanese. This N5 lesson covers time vocabulary: hours, minutes, daily schedules, and expressions like 'at seven o'clock', 'from ~ to ~', and 'how long does it take'. All explanation and examples in Japanese.
